detail: gRPC replay is now in-process via tonic and prost-reflect, replacing the grpcurl shell-out that downloaded a pinned binary mid-run (breaking hermeticity) and only supported five OS/arch pairs. A DynamicCodec over DynamicMessage drives unary, client-streaming, server-streaming, and bidi calls from the protobuf descriptor the CLI already snapshots, with metadata from REPROIT_EXTRA_HEADERS, TLS from the https scheme, a 15s timeout, and server-stream collection bounded by response size and message count. The descriptor pool builds from a .proto or a real FileDescriptorSet; the lossy in-memory CLI descriptor returns a clear error rather than panicking. ensure_grpcurl, the download, and REPROIT_GRPC_PROTO/REPROIT_GRPCURL are deleted. A hermetic in-test HTTP/2 gRPC server covers every call shape and the error path, and the live grpc-go OSS gate passed (complete=true, exercised=1, findings=0).
